note: Required evidence: sample_source_production (archived original accepted production stage JSON), native_sample (schema2 native-sample manifest with exact identity and captures path/sha256), native_capture images, technical_report, gameplay_report, visual_review. All reports schema2 with exact identity. Technical/gameplay reports need passed:true, full passed_check_ids, no errors/failed_check_ids; gameplay_verified:true. Visual review needs actor:user,visual_accepted:true,source_ref matching actual stage approval and passed_feature_ids covering all critical features. Synthetic fixtures are never production evidence. Required sample_inputs evidence is a schema2 sample-inputs manifest authored at H4. identity.sample_inputs_digest = digest(manifest); all reports repeat this identity. This is separate from H3 input_digest, so normal generation does not require predicting future model hashes or reapproving H3. Current listed source/assets/render configuration bytes and discoverable native dependencies are rechecked before expansion. Paths are limited to the project; symlink escapes and external roots are unsupported in this manifest. sample_inputs also binds producer_runtime_digest to core.runtime_snapshot()["sha256"]; runtime changes require new applicable sample validation before expansion. Under complete-visual-sample-v2, captures additionally bind image_id/view_id/camera_id/state_id/framing/visible_layers/missing_layers to approved baseline observation views for the sample spaces. H4 cannot contain missing layers or substitute an interaction closeup for the whole-composition view. Independent review is recorded before user visual_review and approval. New asset-routed-visual-sample-v3 additionally checks sample_inputs.model_task_bindings against every original generated/hybrid source: original completed task, reviewed conditioning images and actual model output identity. Pending model tasks cannot be replaced silently with procedural geometry.
